content: Create activity feed. Container: max-w-2xl mx-auto. Feed item: flex gap-3 py-4 border-b. Avatar: w-10 h-10 rounded-full. Content: flex-1. variants.simple: Create social activity feed with various event types.
variants.detailed: Create activity feed. Container: max-w-2xl mx-auto. Feed item: flex gap-3 py-4 border-b. Avatar: w-10 h-10 rounded-full. Content: flex-1. Actor and action: "John liked your post" with bold actor name. Target: link to affected content. Timestamp: text-xs text-gray-400. Thumbnail: optional small preview of content. Group: "X and 2 others liked your post".
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive activity feed. Activity types: follow, like, comment, mention, share, post, reply, achievement, milestone, system notification - each with unique icon and structure. Activity structure: actor(s), verb, object, target, timestamp, optional preview. Grouped activities: combine similar activities ("X, Y, and 3 others liked your post"), expand to show all. Rich previews: thumbnail for media, snippet for text, embed for links. Actor display: avatar, name (link to profile), verified badge if applicable. Time display: relative ("2h ago"), group by date for older ("Yesterday", "December 15"). Filters: filter by activity type, actor, or content type. Read/unread: visual distinction, mark as read on view or explicitly, "Mark all as read". Actions: quick actions per activity type (reply to comment, follow back, view post). Infinite scroll: load more on scroll, virtualize for performance. Real-time: new activities appear at top with animation, "X new activities" button if scrolled down. Empty state: no activity message with suggestions. Privacy: respect blocking and privacy settings. Aggregation window: combine activities within time window. Notifications: differentiate between activity feed and notifications. Accessibility: semantic list markup, live region for new items, actions keyboard accessible.
